title: the frozen response envelope contract of the api freeze
description: freezes the response envelope and its three outcomes — success, error and cancel — with the stable error code table, the json rpc frame grammar, the servercontract envelope of the site bridge and the stdio and http framing rules; every reply the protocol writes answers in exactly one of the three outcome classes and every error code documents its retry semantics.

outcomes.description: the frozen outcome classes of the response envelope

responseenvelope.description: the frozen versioned response envelope fields

version.description: the frozen protocol version of the envelope

outcome.description: the step outcome of a successful reply

error.description: the error of a failed reply with the code of the stable table

cancelled.description: the marker of a cancelled reply whose partial result rides the payload

errorcodetable.description: the stable error code table with the retry semantics of every code

items.description: the wire frame does not parse as json; the same bytes never parse on a retry
the server routes no method of the name the frame carries; the method table is frozen
the frame parses but its params fail the frozen schema or the negotiation range; the client may retry immediately once its params carry the reviewed fields
the handler failed inside the server; the client retries behind the reviewed backoff
the consent gates refused the call; no retry passes without a new human decision

jsonrpcframe.description: the frozen json rpc frame grammar

jsonrpc.description: the json rpc tag of the frozen wire

id.description: the request id the reply quotes; a string id or null answers the failure classes

method.description: the method name of the frozen routing table

result.description: the result of a successful reply

error.description: the error of a failed reply with the code, message and optional data

serverenvelope.description: the frozen servercontract envelope of the site bridge

version.description: the negotiated servercontract version of the handshake

opid.description: the stable operation id every reply quotes for correlation

token.description: the session token that rides frames only

at.description: the epoch milliseconds of the frame

framingrules.description: the frozen stdio and http framing rules
framingrules.stdio: one newline delimited json frame per block on stdin with one reply frame per line on stdout; the frame size bound stays the user configured limit with no code default
framingrules.http: one json frame per http post body on the localhost listener with the reply in the response body under the same user configured frame size bound; no other verb carries frames
